reason: The README describes a workflow that converts topics, documents, or outlines into editable multi-slide PowerPoint presentations, including content planning, visual preview approval, constrained reconstruction, asset processing, rendering, and delivery checks.

summaries.zh: 将主题、文档或大纲转换为经过内容规划、视觉审核和质量检查的可编辑多页 PowerPoint 演示文稿。
summaries.en: Converts topics, documents, or outlines into editable multi-slide PowerPoint presentations with content planning, visual review, and quality checks.

capabilities: Transforms topics, documents, or outlines into multi-slide editable PowerPoint presentations
Reconstructs editable slides from approved previews or reference images
Processes and validates image and SVG assets
Performs PowerPoint rendering and structural quality checks
